title: Mochizuki Honami — Noise Gives Way To Silence〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. This is so exciting...
I'm ready to play right now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Seriously, Saki, that's all you've been saying for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But I get how she feels.
I'm also really excited.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It is going to be our very first solo show since going pro.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Exactly! And I can't believe how fast everything got decided!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We have to thank Mr. Shindo for working so hard behind the scenes. And we get to play at TONE BASE. It's hard not to be motivated.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We don't have much time to prepare, but we need to give all the people who've been supporting us a good show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, let's all do our best to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Still, it feels like it's been forever since we did a solo show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is gonna be our first one as pros, so we've really gotta put a lot of love into our effects!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Venues on the level of TONE BASE usually offer a pretty wide range of options.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And we'll also want to put everything that we learned about staging from Ms. Naruse into practice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I'd like to try that thing where the lights change colors depending on the lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When Ms. Naruse and her band did that, I could feel myself being drawn into the song. I've wanted to give it a try ourselves ever since.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's a great idea! And if we're talking lights, we could also do that thing, you know? Where the spotlight spins round and round!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (They all sound so excited.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I should jot down these ideas before I forget.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, you guys! I just thought of something great!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Something great?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! We should write a new song for the show!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Since we're doing a solo show, what if we do a surprise reveal of a brand-new song? I bet the audience would love that, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A new song? That would be nice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It'll also make it just that much more special for us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we pencil in that plan? I'll be sure to let Mr. Shindo know.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Alright, once I get home, I'll write up short summaries of all of the ideas they just listed.)
A few hours later
Honami's Room

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think that's about all they said.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Staging, crowd interaction, our set list and new song...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
There's so much we have to do.
And we don't have a lot of time to prepare...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I should put together a schedule as quickly as I can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I need to figure out how long we have to practice, as well as what we have to prepare for each meeting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Mr. Shindo sent me the dates for those meetings. I'll start working off of that...
The next day
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I used this app to make a schedule leading up to our show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Nothing has been finalized yet, so I'd like to hear your opinions. What do you all think?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow... You really put this together in one day?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is so detailed. You even have when the demo for our new song needs to be written, and dress rehearsals for our show. That's pretty huge.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But making this by yourself couldn't have been easy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Don't worry about that. It's important to get a jump on these sorts of things early. Also...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This is a must if we're going to put on the best show we can for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks for always being so on top of things, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we take a closer look at the schedule Honami made for us?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Take it away, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
First, the general concept and set list.
This date here is when we have the effects meeting, so we'll need to know what we want to do by this day at the latest...
